svg.title: Intent Equals Outcome - The Governed Enterprise Agentic Estate
svg.desc: Master architectural schematic: Plain-language human intent enters the bounded harness aperture, operates across the hexagonal capability lattice around the central company-owned data core, halts deterministically at human authorization gates, and lands durable value across enterprise systems (ERP, WMS, CRM), reinforced by continuous evidence-backed learning.

g.text: Human intent commands. The governed estate delivers. Value lands in systems the company owns.
Evidence verifies output · Directly enriches institutional capability & model context for the next cycle
“A leader commands the intent. The estate governs the work. Value lands where the company runs.”
